name: Palmanova (Italy)
description: Maroon field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Palmanova (a lion beneath a palm tree on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Palmanova, a comune in Friuli Venezia Giulia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Palmanova arms — lion beneath a palm tree on blue, crowned, within branches
